content.text:
**Confirmed in the live create/update request schema, not just response models:**

`PUT /vaults/{id_or_name}/items/{key}` → `requestBody` → `VaultItemRequest`:

- `type: "wallet"` → `WalletVaultItemRequest.spec.oneOf` includes **`KernelWalletVaultItemSpec`**, requiring `provider: "kernel"`.
- `type: "card"` → `CardVaultItemRequest.spec` → `CardVaultItemSpec.oneOf` includes **`KernelCardVaultItemSpec`**, requiring `provider: "kernel"`, wallet, amount, currency, merchant name and URL.

Source: [live OpenAPI](https://api.onkernel.com/spec.json). Independently matches official SDK [native card model](https://github.com/kernel/kernel-python-sdk/blob/main/src/kernel/types/vaults/kernel_card_vault_item_spec.py) and [native wallet model](https://github.com/kernel/kernel-python-sdk/blob/main/src/kernel/types/vaults/kernel_wallet_vault_item_spec.py).

The [wallet overview](https://www.kernel.sh/docs/integrations/wallets/overview) currently lists only Link and AgentCard. That page doesn’t expose the native Kernel option present in API/SDK.

**Conclusion:** “Kernel only supports credential items” is contradicted by current request schema. **Still unverified:** whether native payments are enabled for our project, eligible for the user’s card, or succeed on a target merchant. No authenticated calls or live payment performed.
